title: Independent SOC and excited-state test of carbazole Bpin positional isomers
difficulty_reasons: Three fixed molecules require a common excited-state/SOC comparison and validation of near-S1 triplet identity.
The qualitative author hypothesis must be tested without exposing result-bearing states or numerical targets.

paper.title: Breaking the lifetime-efficiency trade-off in blue organic room-temperature phosphorescence through site-directed boronate engineering

data.description: Explicit names, positional identities, formulae, neutral singlet state and PVA measurement boundary for CZ1B, CZ2B and CZ4B.

required_deliverables.description: Validated per-isomer excited-state/SOC results, method provenance, state-character evidence, lifetime comparison and limitations.
